Rules

A rule is Tool or Tool(specifier) — Read, Bash(git status*), WebFetch(domain:example.com). Deny wins over ask, ask wins over allow.

Hooks

A hook is a shell command the agent runs at a lifecycle event. Exit 2 is the only code that blocks; stdout is fed back on UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion and SessionStart.
